title: B Look, read and act
text: Two days later, the boy did the same thing again.
The next day, a wolf came. The boy was afraid.
: Wolf! Wolf! ... Who can help me?
But no one came. The boy cried.
What may happen next? Continue the story and act it out.
The boy was not honest in the story. Why was it bad for him?
